enabled.description: Master switch for Magic Context session window management, continuous turn compaction, and context reduction.

searchEnabled.description: Registers the 'ctx_search' tool for session-history retrieval. Superseded by 'memory_search' when AgentMemory tools are active.

noteEnabled.description: Registers the 'ctx_note' tool for session-scoped notes and nudges.

historianEnabled.description: Enables background session compaction (Historian) to summarize older turns into <session-history>.

historianModel.description: Model identifier for background Historian compaction, for example 'gm/gemini-3.8-flash' or 'lmxu/gpt-5.6-sol'. Empty keeps Historian inactive.

historianThinkingLevel.description: Reasoning effort level for the Historian compaction model: 'off', 'minimal', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh', or 'max'. Empty uses the model default.

agentmemory.enabled.description: Enables the bridge to an external AgentMemory service for cross-session durable memory and recall.

agentmemory.url.description: AgentMemory service REST endpoint URL. AGENTMEMORY_URL environment variable overrides this.

agentmemory.secret.description: Bearer token secret for authenticating with the AgentMemory service. AGENTMEMORY_SECRET overrides this.

agentmemory.project.description: Project namespace for scoping memories in AgentMemory. Defaults to the Git repository root or working directory.

agentmemory.agentId.description: Agent identifier tag passed to AgentMemory. AGENT_ID environment variable overrides this.

agentmemory.capture.description: Captures session lifecycle events, tool outputs, and assistant observations to AgentMemory for background indexing.

agentmemory.inject.description: Admits automatic memory recall as a cache-stable Context Projection block following each user turn.

agentmemory.historianRetrieval.description: Allows the background Historian compaction process to query AgentMemory for project context.

agentmemory.memoryTools.description: Exposes AgentMemory tools to the agent: 'memory_search' (federated search) and 'memory_save' (durable memory write).

agentmemory.requireHttps.description: Enforces HTTPS when sending bearer authentication to non-loopback hosts. Default false permits private networks such as Tailscale.
